title: Voiceflow Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits and Overages
summary: Voiceflow pricing varies by plan and conversation volume. Compare the cost of each tier to find the plan that matches your monthly usage and budget.
body_markdown:
## Activepieces as the Workflow Layer Behind Voiceflow


When the conversation ends and the work begins, Activepieces takes the Voiceflow webhook and carries out the actions across your other apps, with unlimited flows on every plan, including the free one at $0 and 1,000 credits a month, while Voiceflow keeps the conversation itself.


### What it does and does not replace


Ask what happens after the chat, and Voiceflow's native answer is that you build it yourself. Every integration you wire by hand is a maintenance bill you carry.


To move that work into a flow, there is[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/category/marketing) , an open source automation platform with an MIT-licensed core. Its AI agent step can act across 741 integrations, counted from the packages/integrations/community folder of the open source monorepo on GitHub and listed at[https://www.activepieces.com/pieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces) .


That matters for cost because the agent's reach is set by the apps it can touch, not by how much glue code you are willing to maintain.


It doesn't replace Voiceflow's conversation design. Prompts, dialogue paths, knowledge base and channel handling stay where they are.


Activepieces starts at the webhook, and all 741 of its integrations sit on the action side of it, with no opinion about how the chat got there. If your complaint is that the conversation itself is clumsy, a second tool won't fix it.


### Approval step and self-hosting


Picture a refund request. The Voiceflow agent collects the order details and sends a webhook to an Activepieces flow, one of the unlimited flows every plan includes.


The flow pauses at an approval step, so a person signs off before money moves. Only then does it issue the refund in the billing app and add a note to the helpdesk ticket.


The pause is the point. An agent that can refund without a human check is a liability priced per mistake, and the approval step caps that exposure at the cost of a reviewer's minute.


Because the core carries an MIT licence, as the LICENSE file in the GitHub repository shows (the packages/ee/ directories sit under a separate commercial licence), you can also self-host it.


For a team that has outgrown per-run pricing, that means flow volume is limited by your own infrastructure rather than by a plan tier, though you take on running it.


The free plan costs $0 with no card needed, and includes 1,000 credits a month and up to 5 users; you can start it at[https://cloud.activepieces.com/sign-up](https://cloud.activepieces.com/sign-up?ap_cta=blog_body&ref=%2Fblog%2Fvoiceflow-pricing-2026-plans-credits-and-overages) .
